description: Source code for the Rocket UI integration in the Unvanquished game, handling UI initialization, loading menus and HUDs, cursor management, and connection state updates.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_Init
methods.description: Initializes the Rocket UI, loads menu files, sets up properties, and handles connection state changes.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_LoadHuds
methods.description: Loads HUD configurations from specified files and sets up weapon HUD groups.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_Frame
methods.description: Updates the Rocket UI each frame, handling connection state changes, server list updates, and rendering.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetTag
methods.description: Retrieves the tag of the current Rocket UI element.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetAttribute
methods.description: Gets the value of a specified attribute from the current Rocket UI element.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_QuakeToRML
methods.description: Converts Quake-style markup to Rocket Markup Language (RML).

methods.name: CG_Rocket_IsCommandAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a UI command is allowed based on the current game state and element type.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_LoadCursor
methods.description: Loads a cursor shader and scales it according to screen resolution.
